## Track record

- 95% client satisfaction rate.

## Career history

- Web/IT Executive at BritishAUC, 2024 to present.
- No-Code Developer at ICIR, 2021 to 2023.
- Full-Stack Developer at KSolutions, 2014 to 2021.

## Services

- Web Design: visually appealing, user-friendly designs that reflect the client's brand, from wireframes to final prototypes.
- Web Development: functional no-code and full-stack websites that are easy to manage and optimized for performance across devices.
- Brand Identity: cohesive visual branding including logos, color palettes, and typography.
- UX/UI Design: intuitive interfaces and seamless experiences to improve engagement and usability.
- Consultation Services: expert advice and actionable insights for planning and executing design projects.

## Project timelines

- A typical website takes 2-4 weeks; larger projects may take 6-8 weeks.
- A detailed timeline is provided during the initial consultation.
- Revision rounds are included in every project until the client is satisfied.

## Tools

- Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS (plus GSAP, TypeScript, Three.js, Redux, and Web3.js on individual projects).
